description: This file implements the PersistentStore class for a plugin in the WPEFramework, including initialization, deinitialization, and internal management of store interfaces and configuration.

classes.name: PersistentStore
classes.description: A class managing persistent storage for a plugin, handling initialization, cleanup, and interface querying.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the persistent store, sets environment variables, and queries interfaces.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, releases interfaces, and unregisters notifications.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns plugin information as a string.
